messages:
incident-bot: ALERT: realtime p99 latency spike detected for /v1/generate (hosted-api-prod) • rule=latency-p99-eu-us-west • p99=2.12s ↑ (threshold 1.0s) :rotating_light:
priya.kapoor: paging oncall, grabbing dashboards now. any customer reports?
morgan.lang: I'm on it — looking at p95/p99 times in Grafana. p95 ~ 420ms, p99 ~ 2.1s. Streaming stalls visible on the live-tail (us-west1 nodes).
marco.sre: seeing repeated lines in runtime logs: `KVCache: eviction=1 reason=prefix_miss count=48` around the spikes. correlated with a canary rollout of quantized-v2 yesterday.
megan.prod: no 5xx visible in SLOs, but streaming sessions show ~14% stall/retry rate in the last 10m. potentially affecting conversational apps.
oncall-sre: taking page. quick checklist: 1) any recent rollouts? 2) traffic shift? 3) autoscale events?
priya.kapoor: rollout: `model/quantized-v2` canary at 8% since 03:20 UTC. autoscale: no recent scale failures, but instance churn on us-west1 worker pool at 03:25 UTC.
morgan.lang: running a quick trace query: `SELECT count(*) FROM requests WHERE p99>1000 AND region='us-west1' GROUP BY host` -> hotspots on gw-03, worker-07.
marco.sre: tail of worker-07 shows backlog at KV cache layer + large evictions. hypothesis: quantized-v2 changed tokenization/prefix distribution increasing cache churn.
megan.prod: mitigation suggestion: 1) rollback canary to previous stable (quantized-v1), 2) temporarily route streaming traffic away from us-west1 (policy: route by region), 3) enable streaming-fallback to polling for affected routes.
oncall-sre: applying temporary routing policy now: `rbacctl traffic shift --service hosted-api --from-region us-west1 --to-region us-east1 --percent 50` — will monitor.
morgan.lang: started rollback of canary -> `deploy rollback model quantized-v2` (in progress). ETA ~ 4m.
incident-bot: NOTE: change detected by deploy-bot: rollback job #842 started by morgan.lang.
priya.kapoor: checking customer impact matrix — few heavy customers in us-west1 saw degraded latency but no aborts. reaching out to Customer Success to notify top 5 customers just in case.
marco.sre: after partial traffic shift, p99 dropped to ~1.05s on the next sample window. streaming stall rate down to ~6%.
megan.prod: good signal. keep rollback + routing for 30m, then decide permanent fix (KV cache tuning or full rollback of quantized pipeline).
oncall-sre: creating incident ticket INC-2026-173, will hand off to eng-runtime for deep dive. oncall-sre -> assign to marco.sre and morgan.lang.
priya.kapoor: copy — I'm capturing dashboard snapshots and logs into the ticket. Also saving a short query set to reproduce the spike.
morgan.lang: quick repro query attached in ticket. I will run a controlled canary locally against a staging KV cache to validate.
megan.prod: customer comms: draft message ready if we see persistent degradation. for now status: "mitigated, monitoring". :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: ACTION: incident created INC-2026-173 (latency-regression-streaming-kvcache). severity: sev2.
oncall-sre: handing off. final checks? anyone want to take lead for postmortem?
marco.sre: I'll own postmortem and root-cause once deep dive done.
priya.kapoor: thanks all. will update ticket and channel if anything changes.
megan.prod: thanks — keeping an eye on support for customer replies.
